integrity: The proof computes the kernel of every degree-two representation explicitly, counts exact-order residues modulo 2n, and handles the parity-dependent abelianization separately. A standalone checker verifies the nonlinear multiplicity law, collision parity, character degree-squared identity, and involution distinction for n up to 80.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns ordinary cyclic-kernel dicyclic and dihedral groups of order 4n.
The irreducible-character parametrizations are standard; the contribution is the exact codegree-multiplicity formula and parity collision criterion.
Generalized dicyclic groups over arbitrary abelian kernels are not classified here.
title: Dihedral–dicyclic pseudo-algebra collisions obey a parity law
